B-EQUAL-WEIGHT-PMI.expected: null mean < 0.1 if bias were driven by large-stratum dominance (frozen H1)
B-EQUAL-WEIGHT-PMI.note: Null bias INCREASES 1.73x vs weighted (0.704 vs 0.407), 54.2 std above the 0.1 threshold. Equal weighting amplifies the small-stratum plug-in bias (per-stratum null PMI +0.742 for size 5-9 vs +0.379 for size 20-49). Large-stratum-dominance hypothesis for the bias is falsified.

B-MEDIAN-PMI.expected: null mean < 0.1 if bias were driven by outlier strata (frozen H1)
B-MEDIAN-PMI.note: Null bias 0.686 bits, 32.0 std above the 0.1 threshold. Median does not center the null because the per-stratum plug-in bias is pervasive (positive in the majority of strata), not outlier-driven.

B-KNN-CMI.expected: lower null bias than weighted if strata weighting were the root cause (frozen H1)
B-KNN-CMI.note: KNN CMI null mean is -0.262 bits (NEGATIVE bias, 48.5 std from zero). The extra action dimension + Laplace smoothing alpha=1.0 depresses P(Y|Z,X) below P(Y|Z) under the null. |null_mean| = 0.262 >= 0.1 => fails C1.

Bias is environment-level (deterministic/stochastic strata mixing + small-stratum plug-in bias), not estimator-level.

observations: N=5000 data fidelity: regenerated transitions are deep-equal to the parent raw_transitions.json; file SHA256 170df6e3... matches the frozen hash and the in-memory sort_keys hash 46ed606a... matches the parent's raw_results.sha_raw.
B-WEIGHTED-PMI replicates the parent exactly on every replicated quantity: K2=0.933244, K3=1.220508, positive control K3=1.805624 (p=0.000999), N=50000 K2=1.778725, determinism K2 det_ratio=0.315.

All four estimators PASS the positive control (8-state deterministic SPA): K3 = 1.806 (weighted), 1.810 (equal-weight), 1.873 (median), 1.191 (KNN), all with p=0.000999. Every estimator pipeline detects the deterministic signal.

All four estimators FAIL the C1 null control: |null_mean| = 0.407 (weighted), 0.704 (equal-weight), 0.686 (median), 0.262 (KNN) bits, each many standard errors above the 0.1 threshold (54.2, 47.2, 32.0, 48.5 sigma respectively).

Equal-weight and median null bias are WORSE than the weighted baseline (0.704 and 0.686 vs 0.407 bits), not better. The preregistered expectation that bias is caused by large-stratum dominance is contradicted.

Stratum-size bias decomposition (weighted framework, shuffled-action null, K2 records): mean per-stratum null PMI is +0.742 bits for strata of size 5-9, +0.571 for size 10-19, +0.379 for size 20-49. The plug-in per-stratum bias is monotonically decreasing in stratum size; small strata carry the bias.
B-KNN-CMI null mean is NEGATIVE (-0.262 bits, std 0.0075): under shuffled actions the extra action dimension plus alpha=1.0 smoothing depresses P(Y|Z,X) below P(Y|Z). Absolute bias still fails C1.
Descriptive K3-K2 at N=5000: weighted +0.287 bits, equal-weight -0.044, median -0.034, KNN +0.180. Sign and magnitude depend on the estimator; none is interpretable without valid null centering.

Descriptive K2(N=50000) vs K2(N=5000): weighted +0.845, equal-weight +0.247, median +0.373, KNN +1.261 bits. NO estimator is within the frozen 0.2-bit convergence band at N=50000; all four continue to drift with sample size.

Determinism at N=5000 (recomputed from parent code on parent data): K2 (state-history) det_ratio=0.315 (407/1292); K3 (action-history) det_ratio=0.108 (89/821). The parent packet's recorded determinism_K3 (467/821, det_ratio 0.569) is NOT reproducible from the parent's own code and data; the parent's narrative explanation relying on 'K3 56.9% deterministic dilution' does not survive recomputation.
N=50000 K2 for the weighted estimator (1.778725) replicates the parent exploratory value exactly, further confirming end-to-end code fidelity.
validity_notes: Valid scientific negative: status=COMPLETE, outcome=FALSIFIES. All measurements executed successfully; no infrastructure failure. The negative applies to the frozen in-setting hypothesis H1/H0: none of the three bias-corrected estimators (nor the weighted baseline) centers the shuffled-action null below 0.1 bits at N=5000 on the 12-state hash-routed SPA.

The frozen falsifier C1 ('ALL three estimators have null control |mean| >= 0.1') is triggered with margins of 2.6-7.0x the threshold at 32-54 sigma; the verdict does not depend on a knife-edge measurement.

Null control computed on K2 state-history records (parent precedent). The frozen spec declares the shuffled-action null and the 0.1 threshold but does not specify the condition; K2 is the parent-aligned reading used here.

B-KNN-CMI operationalization: I(Y;X|Z) = E[log2 P(Y|Z,X)/P(Y|Z)] via sklearn KNeighborsClassifier k=5 on integer-encoded (Z=url_before+history, X=action, Y=url_after) tuples, self-neighbors excluded, Laplace alpha=1.0 on neighborhood counts to avoid zero probabilities. The frozen phrase 'P(Y|Z) improvement over P(Y)' is interpreted as the conditional version (the estimator is named CMI).

KNN positive-control p uses the global shuffled-action permutation (no strata exist for within-stratum permutation on the stratum-free estimator); the three stratum estimators use the parent's within-stratum url_after permutation (N=1000). Both schemes give p=0.000999 (permutation floor).

Equal-weight and median estimators include zero-variance strata as exact 0.0 contributions (prereg validity threat 3 intent: conservative toward a beyond-Markov positive); strata with n<5 are skipped identically for all three stratum estimators, yielding the same n_strata/n_used as the parent.
Reused parent N=5000 transitions per frozen measurement_validity (same RNG construction, deep-equal regeneration check passed), ensuring identical strata and records across the 4 estimators.
In-memory simulation only (per frozen measurement_validity): no inference to production SPAs, browser-collected data, or real Web dynamics is warranted by any quantity in this packet.

The determinism_K3 discrepancy between the parent packet (467/821) and reproducible recomputation (89/821) is a parent-packet reproducibility finding; it does not alter this experiment's verdict, which rests on the C1 null gate, but should be resolved by the parent's owners.
N=50000 measurements are descriptive (non-gating) because the frozen Phase 2 never engages without a C1 passer; they document convergence impossibility of all four estimators rather than gating it.
p-values for C1 null controls (p~0.002 for weighted/equal/median/KNN) are descriptive only: with null mean this far from zero the permutation p is not the deciding criterion; the |mean| threshold is.
unresolved: No estimator tested here achieves null centering on this SPA class. Whether ANY estimator (KSG CMI, Bayesian model comparison, likelihood-ratio test, consistently smoothed joint) can center a null on deterministic/stochastic mixed strata remains open - truly orthogonal frameworks are untested (parent handoff do_not_assume).
The true sign and magnitude of any beyond-Markov component in the 12-state hash-routed SPA remain unmeasured: no valid estimator exists yet, so the K3-K2 question is unanswered rather than answered.

The small-stratum plug-in bias (+0.74 bits at size 5-9) is present in stochastic strata, so an SPA redesign with 0% deterministic strata may NOT eliminate the bias; this needs a dedicated test before SPA redesign is prescribed.

Whether the KNN CMI negative null bias (-0.262 bits) disappears with different k, alpha, or distance metrics (frozen prereg threat 1 mentions k sensitivity), and whether any KNN parameterization centers the null, is untested.
Asymptotic behavior of all four estimators beyond N=50000 is unknown; none plateaued by N=50000.
Root cause of the parent packet's determinism_K3 record (467/821) versus reproducible 89/821 is unknown and should be audited against the parent's provenance.
